user.title: Connect to Wilma
user.description: Enter your school's Wilma address and your own Wilma login. Each person should use their own account — this is not shared between users.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.description: Your account has MFA enabled. Enter a one-time code from your authenticator app, or paste the TOTP secret/otpauth:// URI once so future logins authenticate automatically.

data.totp_secret: TOTP secret or otpauth:// URI (optional, saves for automatic future logins)

students.title: Choose students
students.description: Pick which students to create sensors for. You can change this later from the integration's options.

error.invalid_mfa: Invalid one-time code or TOTP secret.
error.mfa_code_required: Enter a one-time code or a TOTP secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wilma at this address.
error.no_students: No students found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Wilma account is already configured.
